subject: Security lockstep: evaluation handoff & retention clarification
messages:
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finbridge.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Security lockstep: evaluation handoff & retention clarification

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the product demos last week — team is energized. Before we enter the final review with procurement, Security needs a short mutual action plan (MAP) that clearly documents the compliance gates and evidence handoff. Our target close window is end of November, so we want to confirm acceptance criteria now.

Specifically, can you confirm the following items for Redwood:
- SOC 2: latest attestation date and whether any exceptions exist
- SIG/CAIQ: do you have a populated CAIQ we can review?
- DPA: standard retention clause and options for EU/US residency; do you allow shorter retention windows (e.g., 90d) by contract?
- Evidence handoff: proposed owners, expected folder structure, and timeline for an evidence sprint (we're hoping for a 2-week window)

I've attached our security questionnaire to show the level of detail we typically need. Can you respond with a short MAP (milestones + owners + dates) and the artifacts you will attach?

We'd like to lock a signature meeting the week of Nov 20 if possible.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Security, FinBridge
elena.ruiz@finbridge.com
Attachment: FinBridge-Security-Questionnaire-1.xlsx (spreadsheet)
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-02T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security lockstep: evaluation handoff & retention clarification

Hi Elena — thanks for the clear list. Below is a proposed lockstep MAP and the owners on our side. I'll attach the high-level SOC 2 readout and a CAIQ snapshot for your intake.

Proposed MAP (high level):
1) Evidence intake & workbook share — Owner: Neha Kapoor (Redwood) — Deliver by Nov 10
2) Evidence sprint (2 weeks) — Owner: FinBridge & Redwood joint — Nov 13 to Nov 24
3) Final DPA redline & signature meeting — Owner: Ben Carter (Redwood Legal/Revenue) — sign-off week of Nov 20
4) Go-live / production access cutoff for eval users — contingent on acceptance — target Nov 30

Artifacts we will provide immediately:
- Redwood-SOC2-Readout-2027.pdf (summary, attestation available upon LOI)
- CAIQ snapshot (attached)
- Redwood-DPA-Redline-v1.docx (initial redline we can edit)

Retention & residency note: default retention for logs/trace telemetry is 365 days; for customer data (input prompts + outputs) we propose 365 days with an option for stricter retention by contract (90/180) for EU-regulated customers. We can include an EU-residency requirement as an annex and support export controls via our Private deployment option if needed.

Open question for you: what is your minimum acceptable retention window for evaluation data?

Next steps: Neha will share the evidence workbook and folder layout by Friday (Nov 10). Ben will schedule a signature prep call for the week of Nov 20. Please confirm and I'll circulate a single-sheet MAP that you can attach to procurement.

Best,
Ava Chen
Head of Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
Attachments: Redwood-SOC2-Readout-2027.pdf (pdf), Redwood-DPA-Redline-v1.docx (docx)
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-03T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Internal: FinBridge MAP — evidence owners and sprint plan

Ben / Neha — summarizing the ask from FinBridge: they need a MAP + evidence handoff so procurement can sign by end of month. Key asks below.

Action items (internal):
- Neha: create evidence workbook and Drive folder by Nov 10; mark which artifacts are 'attestation' vs 'operational'
- Ben: prepare talking points for signature call (week of Nov 20) + bring DPA negotiation team
- Ava (me): confirm retention language and provide options (90d/180d/365d) and EU-residency annex

Risks: their security team may push for shorter retention or additional logging traces; we should confirm what can be limited to metadata-only for the eval. Also, verify SOC 2 full report release constraints — we can provide a readout now; full report available on LOI.

Please confirm you can hit the dates. If Neha needs infra assistance for evidence exports, ping Marcus Lin.

Thanks — Ava
From: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finbridge.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@finbridge.com
Date: 2028-11-07T16:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security lockstep: evaluation handoff & retention clarification

Ava — this is helpful, thanks. A few clarifications before we proceed:

1) Retention: for evaluation purposes, FinBridge's default requirement is 90 days for prompt-level data; however we can accept 365 for telemetry/logs. Do you offer a contract-level carveout to cap evaluation data at 90 days?
2) DPA: can you push your redline as a tracked-change DOCX? We will circulate to our legal team for a quick review.
3) Evidence sprint: Nov 13–24 works for us. We will assign two engineers and one reviewer on our side.

I'll attach an acceptance matrix that shows the minimal evidence we need for sign-off. Also propose a 30-minute signature prep call on Nov 21 (15:00 ET) — can Ben and you make that?

If we can get the DPA redline and the SOC2 summary this week, procurement will prioritize the LOI to access the attestation.

Thanks,
Elena
Head of Security, FinBridge
Attachment: FinBridge-Acceptance-Matrix.docx (docx)
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@finbridge.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: 2028-11-08T08:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Security lockstep: evaluation handoff & retention clarification

Elena — thanks for the quick response. Confirming next steps:
- We can include a contract option to cap evaluation prompt data retention at 90 days as an annex; default remains 365 days. I'll get the redline into tracked-changes by EOD Nov 9.
- Neha will share the evidence workbook (Drive link) and CAIQ snapshot by Nov 10.
- Ben will schedule the 30-minute signature prep call for Nov 21 at 15:00 ET and invite procurement + legal.

I'll send the DPA redline and a one-page MAP (milestones + owners + dates) for your folder now. Please confirm the acceptance matrix items you absolutely need for sign-off so we can prioritize.

Looking forward to closing this quickly.

Best,
Ava Chen
Head of Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com
Attachments to follow: Redwood-DPA-Redline-v1.docx (will be updated), Redwood-SOC2-Readout-2027.pdf
